issues.description: Extraction unconditionally requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files, but the repo contains no story files, so the documented demo cannot regenerate outputs.
run_extract has no fallback generator despite the README claiming stories can be loaded or generated.
The tiny end-to-end test fails on a fresh checkout because extraction cannot find data/stories/manifest.json.
The documented make demo and equivalent tiny extraction commands are not runnable from the checked-in repository state.
Validation loads vector artifacts but never verifies that the manifest backend, model, layer count, or vector dimensions match the requested backend.
Preference steering loads vector artifacts without manifest compatibility checks, allowing wrong-backend or wrong-shape runs to fail late or produce invalid comparisons.
pca_components_for_variance returns one component when threshold is 0, so users cannot disable neutral-PC projection via a valid threshold value.
layer_position_mean accepts negative token_start values and silently slices from the end of the sequence instead of rejecting invalid config.
RunConfig does not validate required values such as nonempty emotions, positive topic/story counts, nonnegative token_start, or variance thresholds before runtime.
Saving arrays assumes every configured emotion has extracted data, so bad or empty configs fail with KeyError/stack errors instead of clear validation errors.
HF dtype='auto' is ignored and loads with torch_dtype=None, likely forcing fp32 and making the default Gemma backend unnecessarily memory-heavy.
HF steering assumes decoder layers live at model.model.layers, which makes the backend brittle for supported causal LM architectures outside that layout.
steering.min_reported_emotions is configured but never read; steer_prefs hard-codes four emotions instead.
